school.mottoReflection: Dushishikariza abanyeshuri gukora umurimo bashyizeho umwete, kubaha agaciro ka buri muntu no gusangiza abandi umucyo w'ubumenyi.
school.mission: To promote inclusive education, providing the quality of education, encouraging learners to innovate by enhancing practical skill and stressing the spiritual moral development.
school.vision: To be an outstanding school in teaching and learning where discipline, humanity, moral and spiritual value hold the key to all success

about.badge: Murakaza neza kuri G.S. Busogo I
about.title: Umurage w'indashyikirwa mu bumenyi
about.description: G.S. Busogo I - Saint Benoît ryashinzwe mu 1952. Ni ishuri Gatolika rya Marist ryakira abanyeshuri bataha, ryiyemeje guteza imbere ubumenyi, amasomo mbonezamubano, ukwemera n'imyitwarire myiza.
about.spiritText: Ukwemera, urukundo n'ikinyabupfura muri buri ntambwe.
about.scienceText: Kwiga dukora no kubaka urufatiro rukomeye muri STEM.
about.faithText: Indangagaciro za Marist zishingiye ku gukorera abandi, kwicisha bugufi no kugira umutima mwiza.

pillars.title: Uburezi Gatolika bwa Marist bushingiye ku bumenyi n'imyitwarire myiza

items.title: Umutimanama
items.text: Ubuyobozi bwiza bushingiye ku kwemera, inshingano, kubaha no gukorera umuryango.

items.title: Ubumenyi
items.text: Kwiga dukora, gukoresha ikoranabuhanga no gushakashaka ibisubizo mu isi ihora ihinduka.

items.title: Indashyikirwa
items.text: Intego zisobanutse, akamenyero k'ikinyabupfura n'intsinzi mu masomo bitegura abanyeshuri kuyobora.

curriculum.title: Amashami abiri y'ishuri Gatolika rya Marist
curriculum.description: Ishuri ryacu ryita ku matsiko y'ubumenyi, gusobanukirwa abantu no kugira imico myiza.

streams.title: Ishami ry'Imibare n'Ubumenyi
streams.description: Kubaka ubumenyi bukomeye mu mibare n'ubumenyi binyuze mu myitozo, ubushakashatsi no kwiga ufite ikinyabupfura.

streams.title: Ishami ry'Ubugeni n'Ubumenyi Nkoranyamuntu
streams.description: Kwiga indimi, amateka, ubumenyi bw'isi n'amasomo mbonezamubano, byongera ubushishozi n'ubushobozi bwo kuvugana neza.

stats.label: Abatsinda ku rwego rw'igihugu
stats.detail: Ibyavuye mu bizamini biri hejuru buri gihe

stats.label: Abanyeshuri barangije neza
stats.detail: Abayobozi hirya no hino ku isi

studentLife.title: Ubuzima bw'abanyeshuri bwubaka icyizere n'imico myiza

items.title: Amarushanwa
items.text: Amarushanwa y'ubumenyi yo mu gihugu no mu mahanga, ay'imibare n'ibindi bizamini by'ubumenyi.

items.title: Amakipe n'imiryango
items.text: Itsinda ry'ubumenyi, umuryango w'impaka, itsinda ryita ku bidukikije n'iry'ikoranabuhanga, bifasha kwiga no hanze y'ishuri.

items.title: Gukorera umuryango
items.text: Ibikorwa biyobowe n'abanyeshuri bigirira akamaro umuryango kandi bikawitura.

items.quote: Busogo I yamfashije kugira ikinyabupfura mu masomo no kwigirira icyizere cyo gukomereza amashuri mu mahanga. Ishuri ryanyubatse mu bitekerezo no mu mico.
items.name: Niyogakiza

items.quote: Umuco wo gukunda ubumenyi, ubufasha bw'abarimu n'indangagaciro nziza z'ishuri bituma kwiga hano bitera imbaraga kandi bigatanga icyizere.
items.name: Manzi G.

items.quote: Ndi umubyeyi, nshimira uburyo Busogo I ihuza indashyikirwa mu masomo, ikinyabupfura no kurera imico myiza.
items.name: Mugabo P.

items.title: Amatsinda y'ubumenyi y'ishuri yitwaye neza mu marushanwa y'igihugu
items.text: Abanyeshuri bagaragaje guhanga udushya no kuba indashyikirwa mu marushanwa y'ubumenyi n'udushya.

items.title: Ahigirwa hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga hafunguriwe abanyeshuri bose
items.text: Ibikorwaremezo bishya bifasha mu kwigisha STEM, gukora porogaramu za mudasobwa no gukora ubushakashatsi.

items.title: Ibirori ngarukamwaka bya Marist bikomeje kubaka ubumwe bw'ishuri
items.text: Abanyeshuri, abakozi n'imiryango bahuriye mu birori by'ibyishimo byaranze ukwemera n'ubumwe.
